english.title: In charge of animal carried in a vehicle on a motorway fail ensure it was on a lead / otherwise kept under control
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..) which was being carried by a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), using the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), failed to secure, insofar as was practicable, that the animal, having

(A)_[escaped from]_
(B)_[been removed from or permitted to leave]_

the vehicle, was held on a lead or otherwise kept under proper control whilst not on or in the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 14(b)(ii) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was in charge of **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..) which was being carried in **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..). The animal had

(A)_[escaped from]_
(B)_[been removed from or permitted to leave]_

the vehicle but the defendant failed to ensure that it was kept

(C)_[on a lead]_
(D)_[under proper control]_

whilst it was not in or on the vehicle.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
